rows.issue: 345 MPa is the SR-200 datasheet minimum tensile yield, used as compressive. It is not a sourced compressive minimum at 0.691748 mm or after forming. The historical 379.2 MPa compression is a 1.96 mm sheet lot, not a thin-sheet minimum.
rows.implication: The three-of-five result is conditional on an additional, unvaried material transfer assumption. The card already flags this, so this is a carried source limitation, not an arithmetic error.
rows.source: Materion DS-HPP-613; NASA CR-194164 PDF p.22 Tables 2–3
rows.needed_evidence: Thin-sheet post-form compression and biaxial properties, with gauge and orientation.

rows.issue: The isotropic 0.33 value is inherited from aluminium, not established for SR-200. The cited lot has substantially lower in-plane Poisson ratios.
rows.implication: At nu=.0768, fixed-geometry global SF is 0.961118. Retuning the same gamma/wrinkle/panel set works at usage about 0.883289. This scalar substitution is a sensitivity, not an orthotropic laminate solution.
rows.needed_evidence: A consistent orthotropic shell model and sourced thin-sheet elastic tensor.

inherited_nu03.width_note: Amplitude is from lambda_I=1; rms_worst changes only width to 2.625 and is not a coupled knockdown/tolerance pair.

consistent_nu033.width_note: Amplitude is from lambda_I=1; rms_worst changes only width to 2.625 and is not a coupled knockdown/tolerance pair.

rows.issue: The two filed RMS values use nu=.30 for angular width, while mechanics inherit nu=.33. More substantially, amplitude is inverted from a lambda_I=1 fit and then the RMS width is set to 2.625; that is not a single defect with a demonstrated knockdown/amplitude/RMS tuple.
rows.implication: 45.819441 mm amplitude reproduces. With width nu=.33, the same lambda_I=1 Gaussian gives 0.654416 mm whole-sphere RMS; merely changing width gives 1.717842 mm, not a validated tolerance at the same knockdown. The filed 1.708852 mm is reproduced with width nu=.30.
rows.source: Baizhikova et al., doi:10.1016/j.jmps.2025.106468, Eq.2–3 and section 4.1; MAINLINE-015
rows.needed_evidence: State width and nu together; calculate a coupled defect response for the sandwich, including seams and multiple defects.

rows.issue: The complete subset table reproduces with E=290 GPa even when O3 is selected. Full-named-set mode and family calculations instead use 293.6 GPa. Thus the subset table does not literally couple every O3 strength choice to the stated alternate lot modulus.
rows.implication: Using E=293.6 GPa whenever O3 is selected changes secondary scores, e.g. all five to 0.708874 on the same grid. No subset feasibility changes and no two-member set floats. The chosen three-member set has no O3, so its answer is unchanged.
rows.needed_evidence: Declare whether keeping 290 GPa is intentional conservatism; if grade and strength co-vary, specify interpolation and recompute the usage objective.

rows.field: 019 pressure-swing service assumption versus scored reference pressure
rows.issue: The printed point scores the COMMON reference pressure. The inherited service package includes a 1% pressure swing; its high-pressure structural corner is separate from the low-pressure buoyancy corner.
rows.implication: At +1% external pressure on the same geometry and needed values, global and wrinkle SF are 0.990099, compression 0.990103. This does not contradict the reference-case arithmetic but prevents treating that exact point as covering the complete service package.
rows.needed_evidence: Retune against the specified pressure envelope and retain the separate low-pressure/hot buoyancy budget.

rows.field: O4 today's panel width and headline 0.691748 mm faces
rows.issue: The 609.6 by 1828.8 mm stock limit applies to gauges at least .059 inch; the maximum stock size at the required .0272 inch gauge is unspecified. Forming, joining and gauge retention at a 3.128 m square-equivalent panel are unestablished.
rows.implication: Even the today panel endpoint is a thin-sheet transfer. A uniform minus-0.1016-mm gauge screen at fixed core reduces compression SF to 0.853129 and wrinkling SF to 0.787988; this is a sensitivity, not a prediction of the delivered gauge distribution.
rows.needed_evidence: Supplier-confirmed gauge and dimensions, curved panel takeoff, measured gauge and shape map.

rows.field: 019 fixed reserve and unvaried seam/adhesive assumptions
rows.issue: The correct mass closure still assumes sealed service, zero payload, the chosen weather/water condition, 60 mm strips, 0.2 mm seam adhesive, 1.5 mm core splice and no demonstrated Be/core bond at the nominated film weight. These are explicit inputs, not measured capabilities.
rows.implication: 3M lists .030 and .015 lb/ft² films, with .015 unsupported; nominal areal mass does not qualify the joint. 775.729 kg reserve is spent on the declared condition rather than spare payload. Other service, seal, coating or handling loads need a new budget.
rows.needed_evidence: Weighed sealed sandwich/seam specimen with load transfer and gas-load measurements; declared site and payload.

disposition: Record and route; none stops this completed check.
